subject: Confidential SOC2 report transfer — NDA signature required & audit window clarification
content:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@fintrust.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report access (NDA gating) and audit period

Hi Lauren,

We're preparing our vendor security review for the upcoming investment review. Can you share Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report and any available bridge letter? FinTrust requires an executed NDA on file before receiving the full report.

A few clarifying items from our side:
- Which audit period does the Type II report cover? We need start/end dates to validate coverage against our roster.
- If the most recent Type II is still in progress, can you provide a bridge letter or a summary of controls until it's complete?
- Our legal team is the signatory for NDAs (procurement@fintrust.com).

Appreciate a quick turnaround on whether you can send the NDA template or a DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Olivia Park
Security Analyst
FinTrust Capital

---

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@fintrust.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report access (NDA gating) and audit period

Hi Olivia — thanks for the note. We can absolutely share the Type II report once we have an executed NDA on file. I attached our standard mutual NDA for you to review and sign (see attachment).

Quick answers up front:
- Audit period covered by our most recent Type II: 2024-11-01 through 2025-10-31 (we'll confirm exact dates with security/legal, see Hannah's note below).
- If your timeline needs coverage beyond that window, we can provide a SOC 2 bridge letter summarizing the control posture through the current date.

Next steps I propose:
1) Please either sign the attached PDF and return, or use the DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/link/redwood-nda-fintrust
2) Once we receive the executed NDA we will share the full Type II report via a secure link (report is confidential and gated).
3) Hannah from our Security team will confirm the formal audit window and attach an executive summary while legal countersigns the NDA.

Attachment: Redwood_NDA_for_FinTrust.pdf (PDF, 9 pages)

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Hi all,

Confirming the details on the security side.
- Official SOC 2 Type II audit report covers the period from 2024-11-01 to 2025-10-31 (Type II, scoped to data security and availability).
- We maintain an executive summary that can be shared immediately after NDA receipt: SOC2_TypeII_Executive_Summary_2025.pdf.
- If FinTrust needs assurance beyond the audit window, we can issue a bridge letter that confirms no material control changes as of the date of request; standard bridge language is available.

NDA guidance:
- Our Legal team prefers to countersign our standard mutual NDA; if FinTrust proposes redlines, please route them to legal@redwoodinference.com and copy me. Minor redlines are typically acceptable but we don't remove confidentiality carve-outs.
- For speed, the DocuSign route is fastest. Lauren — if you'd like I can pre-authorize the share once the DocuSign completes.

Attachment: SOC2_TypeII_Executive_Summary_2025.pdf (PDF, 3 pages)

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
